output.reason: [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and [ev-1295567312b0] say the `istiod-remote` Helm chart was replaced by and merged into the `istio-discovery` chart: the old `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote` becomes `istio/istiod --set profile=remote`. Both also say `istio-base` is now required in both local and remote clusters (the excerpt of [ev-1295567312b0] is truncated). Installs that use the old chart therefore have to switch to the new install method, which makes migration-required (action) a fair reading. Confidence is low because neither source says outright what fails if the operator does nothing, and the feature was never officially stable, so 'high' severity is a judgement call.
